Honestly? I'd be more direct, earlier. The other thing I'd change is I'd ask more questions and make fewer assumptions. There were moments where I thought I understood what was happening with someone and I was probably only getting half of it. Michelangelo's family knowing the flight path being the obvious example — I didn't ask, and it never occurred to me to ask, and that information was just sitting there for three days.
